events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: That axle's cracked clean through the hub, not just the spoke. I can weld it right in a day, or you can find someone to weld it wrong in an hour. Your call.

events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: Done right, and it'll outlast the wagon it's bolted to. My father taught this forge its standards, and I haven't lowered them for anybody yet.

events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: Standing work, not a one-time favor. Nobody's put my name on a receipt and meant it like that before.

events.speaker: NAOMI
events.text: Most people fuss over a burn scar or look away from it. You just asked how I got it. I'll take plainspoken over polite every time.
